name: guillemets
description:
Straight double quotes as «ёлочки», opening and closing in turn: «диван "Честер" купить» → «диван «Честер» купить». A phrase with quotes loses the spaces at its edges.

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

Example: semkit read core.csv guillemets write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
